name: ClipData
doc: An editable clip. Cook this once in the asset worker, never on a frame thread.

fields.name: ticksPerSecond
fields.doc: Clip tick frequency. Controllers require all clips to share this frequency.

fields.name: tracks
fields.doc: Exactly one sparse track per skeleton joint, in skeleton order.

fields.name: curves
fields.doc: Animated scalar properties, independent of joint channels.

fields.name: notifies
fields.doc: Notifies in increasing time order; equal-time order is preserved.
